Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes:

| Restaurant | Location | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|----------|-----------------------|
| **Siam Square** | 1111 N Clark St (West Loop) | Offers a dedicated vegetarian menu with curries, pad thai, and fresh spring rolls. |
| **The Wok** | 2000 W Belmont Ave (West Side) | Has a “Vegetarian” section on its menu featuring tofu pad see ew, vegetable curry, and veggie dumplings. |
| **Baan Thai** | 400 S Wabash Ave (Loop) | Provides a separate vegetarian menu with options like green curry with vegetables, tofu satay, and vegetable fried rice. |
| **Mango Tree** | 500 N Clark St (Loop) | Serves vegetarian pad thai, vegetable khao soi, and tofu in various curries. |
| **Thai Kitchen** | 1200 W Washington Blvd (West Side) | Offers vegetarian pad see ew, vegetable curry, and tofu spring rolls. |

All of these places have positive reviews for their vegetarian offerings and are conveniently located throughout the city. If you’d like more details—such as exact addresses, phone numbers, or opening hours—I can look those up for you.
